name: Mount Emei Scenic Area, including Leshan Giant Buddha Scenic Area
description: In Sichuan Province, Mount Emei is one of Buddhism's holiest mountains. China's first Buddhist temple was built here in the 1st century AD, and many more followed among forests that range from subtropical to subalpine, with some trees over 1,000 years old. Nearby, an 8th-century Buddha 71 metres tall is carved into a cliff above the meeting of three rivers, making it the largest stone Buddha in the world.
